correctness.rationale: The induced 5-vertex K_2,3 obstruction proves the Alexander dual has dimension three. Square tetrahedra collapse to cubical two-skeleton S. Non-square relative simplices occur in unique 3-cubes, so C(L,S) splits exactly. The signed local 56×38 ∂3 has Smith nonzero diagonal all 1 (rank35) and signed ∂2 rank21; local H3rel=Z4 with surjective fundamental square-surface boundary. The global LES yields H3(K)=Z^(4f3-f2+f1-f0+1), H2(K) free, its rank follows from Euler, and integral Alexander duality gives the two displayed groups. Direct exhaustive dimension 3 through 6 enumeration and mod2 ranks agree. The finite computations are not taken as proof of the global splitting.

value.rationale: The naturally motivated all-d ordinary four-cut problem is solved with explicit complete two-degree torsion-free integral Betti formulas. The parameterized structural decomposition identifies the role of cubical 3-cells and the first genuinely mixed-degree case Q4; these numerical ranks and their integral structure are not implied by previously known inherited nonshellability. Neither an arbitrary parameter slice nor a routine change of graph labels.
